list.heading: Sites
list.subtitle: Websites served from this server.
list.emptyDescription: Create the first site to start serving a domain.

form.heading: New site
form.subtitle: The panel checks these values before sending them, and the server checks them again.

hints.aliases: One hostname per line. The same vhost answers all of them.
hints.phpVersion: Only versions installed on this server can be selected.
hints.proxyUpstream: Host or host:port requests are forwarded to, for example 127.0.0.1:3000. No scheme, path or query.

form.noPhpVersions: No PHP versions are installed on this server.

errors.accountRequired: Choose the account that will own the site.
errors.domainInvalid: Domain must be a valid hostname.
errors.proxyUpstreamRequired: Upstream is required for a reverse-proxied site.
errors.proxyUpstreamInvalid: Upstream must be a host or host:port, with no scheme or path.

detail.heading: Site
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted since this link was made.
detail.confirmEnable: Enable this site? It starts serving its own content again.
detail.confirmDisable: Disable this site? It keeps its vhost and answers with a suspension response.
detail.confirmDelete: Delete this site? Its vhost is removed and the domain stops being served. The files in the document root are left on disk.

logs.emptyDescription: Start tailing to read this site's log as it is written.
logs.truncatedNotice: The oldest lines have scrolled out of this view.

endReason.completed: The log ended: the server had nothing further to send.
endReason.dropped: The stream was dropped because this view fell behind. Start tailing again to continue.
endReason.idle: The stream closed after a period with nothing logged.
endReason.truncated: The stream ended without saying why — lines may be missing.
